title: Headless Exploring Vault 74 (VT74): from the trigger inside the vault (10) to the overseer's note carried out (100, complete)

actions.text: Path: walking into Vault 74 (VT74stage10triggerSCRIPT, OnTriggerEnter by the player) sets 10; the player takes the overseer's note (VT74aQuestNote) from the Overseer's Office; standing in the end trigger with the note (VT74EndTRIG, OnTrigger) sets 100 (Complete Quest, 100 XP). Stand-ins: travel by move_player; the walks into the two triggers by trigger_enter; the vault's ghouls are not fought.
Stand-in for the walk to the Overseer's Office: the player picks the note up (its default activation).
Stand-in for the walk back into the end trigger: the player is in it this frame (OnTrigger).
